preservedOriginalBitmaps.exportMethod: Original uploaded bitmap image fill downloaded through Figma MCP, preserved at its source resolution.
preservedOriginalBitmaps.notes: The original Figma banner layer itself uses an uploaded full-screen screenshot. The full 869x1884 bitmap is preserved, and the Unity banner reproduces the Figma clipped image fill using UV cropping; it is not an independent vector banner.

notes: The SVG files are original full component exports. Their PNG partners are rasterized from vector at 4x; source bitmap components are separately identified.
GearFrozen_Full.png, StonePhase1_Full.png and PeanutDrone2_Full.png are Figma PNG exports of mixed image/vector nodes at scale 4, rather than SVG-derived images.
BannerSource.png is an original Figma image fill containing a screenshot; Unity displays the same banner region by UV cropping the preserved full bitmap.
Export bounds can include strokes or effects outside nominal node dimensions. File dimensions and current SHA-256 digests are recorded per file.
